evaluation.step_instruction: A. Think about what the question means and what the concerns of the <client_name> might be. If the question concerns a service, interpret "service" as the full operating model: people, process, data, and technology. Do not evaluate it as only a technology, tooling, or delivery-process question unless the tender explicitly narrows the scope. B. Review the answer to assess the relevance to the question - have all aspects of the question been answered fully and to a detailed level? For service questions, check whether the answer covers relevant people, process, data, and technology dimensions. If a word limit applies, load ibm-bid-word-count and verify compliance with that skill's existing count_words_in_markdown.py script. Do not use wc -w, pandoc, editor counts, model-estimated counts, copied snippets, one-off Python, JavaScript, shell pipelines, or any custom counting code. If no valid writer-supplied script result exists, place the evaluator-facing answer in a temporary markdown file and run the ibm-bid-word-count script before scoring. C. Comprehensiveness of the response - does the answer cover all necessary points? For service questions, check whether it explains the operating model end to end: roles and responsibilities; governance and workflows; records, reporting, metrics, data quality, privacy, and interoperability; platforms, tooling, automation, integrations, resilience, and security controls. D. Demonstration of {{.client_name}} knowledge and best practices (refer to the client context document) If a client language profile exists, use it to check whether the answer follows the client's vocabulary, tone, characteristic phrases, and language-to-avoid rules. Check ../tmp/ibm-bid-project.md for client_language_analysis_artifact first; if no tracker path is present, fall back to ../tmp/ibm-bid-client-language-analysis.md. E. Alignment with {{.proposal_name}} principles and guidelines
evaluation.analysis_instructions: Conduct your detailed analysis inside <detailed_analysis> tags. Provide a detailed analysis of each of the evaluation criteria - List relevant quotes from both the context document and the proposed answer. - If a word limit applies, include the exact ibm-bid-word-count command, count, limit, and status. Penalise over-limit answers under relevance and recommend revision before submission. This will help ensure a thorough and transparent evaluation. It's acceptable for this section to be quite long. After your analysis, provide a detailed justification for your score and assign a score appropriate to the scoring criteria
evaluation.output_format:
Present your final evaluation in the following format:
<evaluation> <justification> [Your detailed justification here] </justification> <score> [Your numerical score here based on the scoring criteria] </score> </evaluation>
Ensure that your justification is thorough, directly relates to the scoring criteria and {{.proposal_name}} principles, and reflects the quality of the answer based on your analysis.
